settings.heading: About Us
settings.subtext: Tournament-grade paddles, courts and gear designed with athletes, engineered for the next generation of pickleball.

settings.heading: Built Different
settings.text:
Xdegree was built by players who refused to settle. We saw a sport growing faster than the equipment serving it - paddles built to a price point, not a standard - and we knew there was a better way. So we started from scratch. We studied the game obsessively, spoke with players at every level, and asked one question relentlessly: what does a paddle truly need to do? The answer became our blueprint, and Xdegree was born from that pursuit.

Every paddle we make is the result of deliberate engineering and genuine passion for the craft. We test materials for feel, not just specification. We refine geometry until the balance feels instinctive in your hand. Performance, durability, comfort, and style aren't trade-offs at Xdegree - they're standards we hold together, because players deserve equipment that works as hard as they do. From your first rally to your most competitive match, precision and confidence should never be a question of budget or experience level.
